BEFORE YOU CONFESS

questions.

Honest answers. Obviously.

What is the 7 Deadly Sins Test?＋

This is a free, original 21-question quiz about everyday habits. Answer the questions to see your seven scores, leading tendencies, character explanation, and a downloadable PNG card. It is independent and is not the IDRlabs test.

Is this about the Seven Deadly Sins anime?＋

This quiz explores seven traditional personality archetypes. It does not match you to anime characters. Our little monsters are original characters created for this site.

How long does the quiz take?＋

There are 21 short questions. Allow about three to five minutes, and take as much time as you like. You can go back and change an answer before revealing your result.

What do the scores actually mean?＋

Each tendency has three equally weighted questions, scored 0 to 4. Balancing statements are reversed (4 minus the answer). The total out of 12 is divided by 12, multiplied by 100, and rounded. Scores are independent and do not add up to 100. A tie stays a tie. These are not percentiles, validated thresholds, or a moral judgment.

Is it free, and do I need an account?＋

The complete quiz, seven-score result, character explanation, and downloadable result card are free. No account or email address is required.

Where do my answers go?＋

Answers are scored in your browser and saved in this tab’s session storage so you can resume after refreshing. They are not submitted to a quiz server. Result links contain all seven scores after #, so share only if you are comfortable sharing your profile. Open Privacy in the footer for the full explanation.

Is the test scientifically validated?＋

No. These are original entertainment questions, not a validated psychological scale. Use the result as a lighthearted conversation starter, not a diagnosis, moral judgment, or fixed personality label.
